description: This file declares the interface class IFactories within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, providing virtual methods for web request handling and related functionalities. It also includes deprecated type definitions for WorkerPool and Factories.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class defining virtual methods for web request and response handling, file body access, and JSON RPC support.
